project.tagline: Keep your site ready for what finds it next.
project.oneLine: SiteCurrent is the product-facing adaptive website improvement system built on Agent-Ready Web Profile (ARWP), turning current Search, AI and agent guidance into site-specific, verifiable changes.
project.boilerplate: SiteCurrent is the product-facing adaptive website improvement system built on the open-source Agent-Ready Web Profile (ARWP) project. It maintains dated best-practice intelligence, audits what actually applies to a target website, compiles that evidence into exact upgrade recipes, can promote safe grounded work into digest-gated repository changes, verifies implementation and keeps Search/AI outcome evidence separate from technical completion claims. ARWP remains the technical project, package and interoperability foundation.

facts.text: SiteCurrent is the product brand; Agent-Ready Web Profile (ARWP) remains the open-source technical project and package identity.
The Adaptive Site Upgrade Engine combines target-site evidence with dated best-practice intelligence and marks stale recommendations review-due rather than treating them as permanent advice.
The Target-Site Transformation Engine uses allowlisted paths and digest preconditions and does not expose a direct-main production transformation mode.
The ARWP Resolver preserves source authority and conflicts instead of collapsing heterogeneous discovery evidence into a single readiness score.
SiteCurrent separates implementation success from Search ranking, AI citation, referral and conversion outcomes and preserves neutral or negative evidence.
